name: Cold clear, aurora night
story: Still, cold and utterly clear after the showers. A quiet day of long views and low light; and then, an hour after dusk, the northern sky begins to move: curtains of green with red at their tops, rising to the zenith by midnight. The night of the season.
forecast: Clear and cold, 5 C at dawn. Calm, northwest 4 kt in the afternoon. Visibility 100 km. Clear night: STRONG aurora expected from 21:00, overhead around midnight.
